rows.source: OPSS consumer product marking and registration
rows.verified: Regulated consumer products should carry the applicable conformity marking for the market in which they are sold.

rows.source: OPSS consumer product marking and registration
rows.verified: Manufacturer or importer identification supports traceability when a safety problem emerges.

rows.source: OPSS consumer product marking and registration
rows.verified: Consumers should follow product instructions and safety warnings supplied with the item.

rows.source: OPSS consumer product marking and registration
rows.verified: Registering household products can allow manufacturers to contact owners directly about repairs or recalls.

rows.source: OPSS consumer product marking and registration
rows.verified: A product recall may provide a repair, replacement or refund depending on the corrective action.

rows.source: OPSS consumer product marking and registration
rows.verified: Second-hand products should still be checked for recalls, damage and missing safety information.

rows.source: OPSS consumer product marking and registration
rows.verified: Unknown online sellers and missing traceability details are warning signs when purchasing safety-critical goods.

rows.source: OPSS consumer product marking and registration
rows.verified: Consumers should stop using a product when official recall instructions say it presents a safety risk.

rows.source: OPSS consumer product marking and registration
rows.verified: Product risk depends on design, conformity, condition, installation, maintenance, user group and foreseeable misuse.

rows.source: OPSS consumer product marking and registration
rows.verified: General product-safety evidence is product-, supplier-, market-, condition- and user-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.

rows.source: OPSS consumer fireworks safety
rows.verified: Consumer fireworks should be purchased from reputable retailers and checked for appropriate UKCA or CE marking.

rows.source: OPSS consumer fireworks safety
rows.verified: Firework instructions and required safety distances should be read before lighting.

rows.source: OPSS consumer fireworks safety
rows.verified: Used fireworks should be allowed to cool, soaked in water and disposed of safely.

rows.source: OPSS consumer fireworks safety
rows.verified: Fireworks stored at home should be kept secured away from children and animals.

rows.source: OPSS consumer fireworks safety
rows.verified: Adult category fireworks cannot legally be bought by people under 18.

rows.source: OPSS consumer fireworks safety
rows.verified: Category 4 fireworks are restricted to professional users.

rows.source: OPSS consumer fireworks safety
rows.verified: Fireworks must not be set off or thrown in streets or other public places.

rows.source: OPSS consumer fireworks safety
rows.verified: Consumers should check that their available space meets the safety distance stated for the firework category.

rows.source: OPSS consumer fireworks safety
rows.verified: Firework risk depends on category, condition, space, weather, ignition, audience distance, storage and supervision.

rows.source: OPSS consumer fireworks safety
rows.verified: Consumer-firework evidence is product-, location-, timing-, operator- and audience-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
